_about: Black & White sealed products: what the box holds besides packs and promos. Written 2026-10-01 from /mnt/project-files/every-era/bw/research/theme-decks.md, box-contents.md and trainer-kits-and-energy.md (research by r-bw). Folded into data/box-contents.json by build_box_contents.py (black_white()). Rows match products by set + TCGplayer id, else by the deck's name inside the product's id or name. Every card number of every deck list was checked against the pkmn.gg checklist of that set (the card name at that number agrees, except the two Blend Energy names, which pkmn.gg spells out in full).

sources: Bulbapedia Black & White TCG Series merchandise ('five copies of each basic Energy card (40 cards in total)')
ToyWiz title and body ('40 Pokemon TCG Energy Cards')
Bulbapedia Elite Trainer Box (TCG) ('40 Basic Energy cards')
Bulbapedia Black & White TCG Series merchandise ('five basic Energy cards from each of the eight types')
Bulbapedia Elite Trainer Box (TCG) ('40 Basic Energy cards')

etb.note: The print is the era's only basic Energy design on the site (print bw); no source says which print the real ETB held. Both ETBs: no Fairy, no promo card.

sources: pkmn.gg tk5a / tk5b (30 cards each, #30 holofoil) and the 60 TCGplayer card listings 98671-98730
kits.note: The real kit also held one booster pack (Black & White per Bulbapedia, Emerging Powers per PokeBeach); not dealt.
